page.title: Portal & branding
page.seoDescription: Your reporter portal's addresses and look.
page.intro: Reporters reach your organization at its portal address. Each legal entity can have its own address, and the address a report starts at decides its entity. Branding is shown on the portal and printed on QR posters.

addresses.intro: Give each entity's people their own address (or poster): a report started at an entity's address belongs to that entity for good, and one started at the organization's address has no entity.
addresses.tenantReadOnly: Set by the platform. It can't be changed here.
addresses.noBaseUrl: The platform's portal base address isn't set, so no address can be reached and no poster can be downloaded. Ask Xposer support.
addresses.slugHint: 3–40 characters: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.

slug.format: Use only lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, with no hyphen at the start or end.
slug.reserved: This word is reserved. Choose another address.
slug.taken: Another entity of your organization already uses this address.

addresses.activeHint: When off, the address shows “page not found” and reports can't start there.
addresses.changeWarning: Changing the address breaks anything already printed with the old one, such as QR posters.
addresses.removeBody: {{url}} will stop working, and posters for it can't be downloaded until it has an address again.
addresses.affectedPosters_one: {{count}} poster uses this address and needs reprinting:
addresses.affectedPosters_other: {{count}} posters use this address and need reprinting:

branding.intro: How your portal looks. The same name, colours and logo are printed on QR posters. An entity's empty fields use the organization's.
branding.entityNote: Fields you leave empty use the organization's branding.
branding.nameEnHintEntity: Empty uses the organization's display name.
branding.previewHint: Shows unsaved changes over what the portal shows now.

logo.title: Logo
logo.hint: PNG or JPEG, up to 512 KB.
logo.tooLarge: The logo is larger than 512 KB.
logo.wrongType: Use a PNG or JPEG image (SVG and GIF aren't accepted).
logo.removeBody: The portal and posters will show the display name without a logo.
logo.removeBodyEntity: The entity will show the organization's logo instead.
